description: This Java source file is a Spring MVC Controller managing product attribute-related admin operations, such as listing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting product attributes in a web application.

classes.name: ProductAttributeController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling CRUD operations and views for product attributes within the admin interface.

methods.name: displayProductAttributes
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of attributes for a specific product, verifies access rights.

methods.name: pageAttributes
methods.description: Handles POST requests to provide a JSON pagination response with product attribute data for a specific product.

methods.name: displayAttributeEdit
methods.description: Displays the attribute editing page for a given product and attribute ID.

methods.name: displayAttributeCreate
methods.description: Displays the attribute creation page for a given product.

methods.name: displayAttribute
methods.description: Shared private method to set up the model for editing or creating a product attribute.

methods.name: saveAttribute
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a product attribute, including validation and processing of attribute type.

methods.name: deleteProductPrice
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a product attribute, with authorization checking.

methods.name: checkAttributeType
methods.description: Returns JSON data indicating the type of a product option, used via AJAX.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up menu context and navigation highlighting for views.
